ADC_ACTION_PARAM_TYPES

Table to store ADC action parameter types.

Columns
capt_id

PK, technical key

capt_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, translatable NAME

capt_pmg_name

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, Fixed value ADC

capt_capvt_id

Reference to ADC_ACTION_PARAM_VISUAL_TYPES, type of visual control to use for this parameter type

capt_select_list_query

Optional SQL query for static or dynamic parameter types

capt_select_view_comment

Optional comment to explain what the select list contains

capt_sort_seq

Sort criteria

capt_active

Flag to indicate whether parameter type is in use

References

capt_pti_id, capt_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg) capt_capvt_id - references ADC_ACTION_PARAM_VISUAL_TYPES (capvt_id)
